title: Prefetching & SSR
description: Master prefetching strategies and server-side rendering integration with React Query for optimal UX.
longDescription: This module covers advanced prefetching techniques with React Query including prefetching on hover and on mount, SSR/SSG integration with Next.js, hydration strategies, using prefetchQuery and fetchQuery, and how to coordinate server-side data fetching with client-side cache. You will learn to make your application feel instant by anticipating user intent, eliminating loading states during navigation, and combining server-side data fetching with React Query's powerful client-side caching layer.
whatYouLearn: Implement prefetching on hover and route change for instant navigation
Integrate React Query with Next.js SSR/SSG using dehydrate and hydrate
Coordinate server-side data fetching with client-side cache state
Use prefetchQuery and fetchQuery for programmatic data prefetching
Avoid hydration mismatches and duplicate network requests
Build visibility-based and lifecycle-coordinated prefetching systems
